title: Pork Carnitas
subtitle: Chipotle Clone
steps: Set the Instant Pot to Saute Mode with High Heat.
Trim the fat from the pork, then cut into large 2” chunks and season with salt and pepper.
Brown the chunks in oil when the pot is hot enough (it will beep).  It’s best to sear in batches so that you don’t crowd the pot.
Cancel Saute Mode and deglaze the pot with chicken stock (or water), adding back all the pork and any rendered juice.
Add the remaining ingredients (juniper berries, thyme, bay leaves) and mix lightly to distribute.
Lock the lid and pressure cook on High for 60 minutes, then naturally release the pressure (approximately 15 minutes).
Transfer the pork to another dish to shred, then mix in ½-1 cup of the juices from the pot.
Serve with tortillas, lime wedges, diced onion, and cilantro.
